answer: Voting weight can be bought only by burning a small fee each epoch, like water cutting through karst: the burn is refunded only when the agent vote matches the eventual consensus of a randomly drawn jury. An honest agent votes carefully and gets its money back, climbing toward the summit of influence for free. A sybil farmer must burn a fee per fake per vote, and fakes voting in lockstep fail consensus and lose every burn, stranded in the tundra of wasted capital. Cloning keys multiplies the burn, not the vote.
